description:
Smart Glass Technologies is looking for a Senior Frontend Developer to lead the development of modern, high-performance web interfaces for our internal tools, client portals, and project management systems. You will work closely with our product, operations, and backend teams to turn complex manufacturing and logistics workflows into simple, intuitive, and responsive user experiences.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain modern, responsive web interfaces for internal tools, client portals, and dashboards.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to design and integrate REST/GraphQL APIs.
  • Translate product requirements and UX/UI designs into maintainable frontend architecture.
  • Own key parts of the frontend codebase, improving code quality, structure, and performance.
  • Implement reusable components, design systems, and UI patterns.
  • Optimize applications for speed, scalability, and reliability across browsers and devices.
  • Participate in code reviews and mentor less-experienced developers.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional frontend development experience, with at least 3 years on a modern framework (React, Vue, or Angular; React preferred).
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript, modern HTML5 and CSS3.
  • Proven experience building complex, data-heavy web applications.
  • Solid understanding of state management and component-driven architecture.
  • Experience integrating REST and/or GraphQL APIs.
  • Strong knowledge of responsive design, cross-browser compatibility, and accessibility.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD workflows, Git, and modern build tools.
  • Excellent communication skills in English in a fully remote team.

Benefits

  • Fully remote position with a geographically distributed team.
  • Influence over the architecture and frontend stack of core products.
  • Direct collaboration with decision-makers and short feedback loops.
  • Professional growth: feature ownership, mentoring, and a path to tech lead.
